import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
import unittest


_DOCTEST_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "doctest.py"
_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("doctest_under_test", _DOCTEST_PATH)
doctest = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(doctest)


class ExceptionNotesRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_doctest(self, source, globs=None):
        source = textwrap.dedent(source)
        test = doctest.DocTestParser().get_doctest(
            source, globs or {}, "exception_notes", __file__, 0
        )
        return doctest.DocTestRunner(verbose=False).run(test, out=lambda _: None)

    def assert_doctest_passes(self, source, globs=None):
        result = self.run_doctest(source, globs)
        self.assertEqual(result.failed, 0)

    def test_ordinary_exception_note_is_compared(self):
        self.assert_doctest_passes(
            """
            >>> exc = ValueError("message")
            >>> exc.add_note("note")
            >>> raise exc
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ValueError: message
            note
            """
        )

    def test_multiple_notes_are_compared_in_order(self):
        self.assert_doctest_passes(
            """
            >>> exc = RuntimeError("message")
            >>> exc.add_note("first note")
            >>> exc.add_note("second note")
            >>> raise exc
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            RuntimeError: message
            first note
            second note
            """
        )

    def test_syntax_error_family_ignores_location_and_compares_notes(self):
        for exc_type in (SyntaxError, IndentationError, TabError):
            with self.subTest(exc_type=exc_type.__name__):
                self.assert_doctest_passes(
                    f"""
                    >>> exc = exc_type("bad syntax", ("actual.py", 23, 5, "bad syntax"))
                    >>> exc.add_note("first note")
                    >>> exc.add_note("second note")
                    >>> raise exc
                    Traceback (most recent call last):
                      File "ignored.py", line 999
                        ignored source decoration
                        ^
                    {exc_type.__name__}: bad syntax
                    first note
                    second note
                    """,
                    {"exc_type": exc_type},
                )

    def test_incorrect_expected_note_fails(self):
        result = self.run_doctest(
            """
            >>> exc = ValueError("message")
            >>> exc.add_note("actual note")
            >>> raise exc
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ValueError: message
            wrong note
            """
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.failed, 1)

    def test_exception_without_notes_keeps_existing_behavior(self):
        self.assert_doctest_passes(
            """
            >>> raise LookupError("message")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            LookupError: message
            """
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
